summary.text: Long Liu is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 49 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Mike Fong (D).
An attorney and business owner, he advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Long Liu, who also goes by David, earned a Ph.D. from Whittier Law School, and his career experience includes working as an attorney and business owner.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Liu described himself as a father, lawyer and published author who hosts a podcast on political and social issues.
He said his campaign opposed Assembly Constitutional Amendment 7 and Assembly Bill 957, and criticized homelessness, crime, taxes, the education system and gas prices in California.
Liu advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary for Assembly District 49 with 31.8 percent of the vote, behind Fong's 68.2 percent.
